deviations.what: create_forum_post also caps the thread name at 100 characters and the content at MAX_CONTENT (2000), and adds Discord's 4xx message (at most 200 characters) to the error
deviations.reason: post_message already caps content at MAX_CONTENT; the cap is a last-resort guard so a too-long field is never sent as a 400 — t5 still cuts the title at a word and continues long text as replies before calling it

deviations.what: t3 acceptance criteria 1 and 4 conflict; resolved as: the code brief names newspaper, transcript and recording always resolve to their code text, any other name resolves against the actor's params.briefs
deviations.reason: criterion 1 says actor briefs are looked up first, criterion 4 says an actor brief named like a code brief does not replace it; the spec (c20, h23) intends that code briefs stay locked, so code names win and only new names come from config

deviations.what: split_at parts: headings shallower than split_at before the first heading of exactly that rank stay in the lead '' part; a page with no such heading is one '' part (the literal 'rank <= split_at' rule applies only after the first exact-rank heading)
deviations.reason: the instruction (every heading of rank <= split_at starts a part) contradicts t1's own acceptance test (h1 masthead must be the '' part); decider: hybrid 0.55, exact_only 0.22, literal 0.17, but P(predictable)=0.22, so the fallback to the literal rule was dropped to keep the rule one sentence

deviations.what: check_actor_briefs also guards actor create, applies to every actor kind, and runs on the model-actor routes through save_check; the auth/policy.py docstring line naming briefs moves to t6
deviations.reason: save_check is the single place check_runner_commands runs, so one wiring line covers create, update, import and model routes; policy.py is outside t4's files

deviations.what: discord.message forum path: empty tags without thread_name accepted; blank thread_name refused; pieces keep their trailing line break so they join back with ''; a blank later piece is not posted; the after-thread error also names the starter id; forum handling sits in the shared MessageAction path, so the legacy message kind naming a Discord actor would honour thread_name though its catalogue entry does not list it
deviations.reason: interpretations the brief left open, each covered by a test; the legacy message kind exposure is undocumented surface

deviations.what: t7 opens the PR only after t8's live test passes and /validate-delivery and /summarize-delivery are done; t8 runs on a pre-merge build of rules/discord-sections rolled out to the nodes; t9's 3-issue check on the Jetson forum continues after the PR as follow-up evidence
